name: Role-based access in the database
how_implemented: Three NOLOGIN roles (admin, clinician, executive) hold the privileges. The API login has none of its own and switches into one role per request, so the database decides what each person may read.
how_to_verify: Data catalog: locked columns show LOCKED. Control test "API login holds no privileges of its own" on the Risk and compliance page (admin view).

name: Row-level security by clinic
how_implemented: Policies on the patient tables limit a clinician to patients of their own clinic. With no clinic set, they see nothing.
how_to_verify: Control test "Row-level security is on for every patient table" on the Risk and compliance page (admin view). Sign in as a clinician: only one clinic's patients appear.

name: Column grants hide direct identifiers
how_implemented: full_name and birth_date are readable by no role. The demo can write names but nothing can read them back.
how_to_verify: Control test "No role can read names or birth dates" on the Risk and compliance page (admin view).

name: Audit trail
hipaa_ref: 164.312(b) Audit controls; 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D) Information system activity review
how_implemented: Every sign-in, failed sign-in, data view, denied request, patient add/remove and assistant question is written to app.audit_log. Roles can insert; only admin can read; nobody can update or delete through the app.
how_to_verify: Audit log page. Control test "Audit log cannot be edited by app roles" on the Risk and compliance page (admin view).

name: Unique user identification
hipaa_ref: 164.312(a)(2)(i) Unique user identification; 164.312(d) Person or entity authentication
how_implemented: Each person has their own account with a bcrypt password hash. Every audit row carries the user id.
how_to_verify: Audit log "Who" column. Gap: demo accounts share a published password, and there is no multi-factor sign-in.

name: Sign-in throttling
how_implemented: The sign-in route is limited to 30 attempts per 15 minutes per IP address. Failed attempts are logged without storing what was typed.
how_to_verify: Security metrics: failed sign-ins. Gap: no per-account lockout.

name: Session expiry
how_implemented: Sign-in tokens expire after 8 hours. There is no idle timeout and no way to revoke a token early.
how_to_verify: Read api/src/server.ts (expiresIn). Gap: no idle logoff or revocation.

name: Encryption in transit
how_implemented: The live site is served over HTTPS by the hosting provider, and the database connection uses TLS.
how_to_verify: Open the live site: the address starts with https. Provided by Render and Neon; I have not audited their configuration.

name: Encryption at rest and physical safeguards
how_implemented: Handled by the cloud providers hosting the database and web service. CareBoard adds nothing of its own.
how_to_verify: Not verified by this project. Would need the providers' compliance documents.

name: Read-only, narrow role for the AI assistant
how_implemented: Carry runs as role_assistant: read-only, two summary tables, five-second timeout, SQL checked before it runs. It has no access to patient, user or audit tables.
how_to_verify: Control test "The assistant role cannot reach patient, user or audit data" on the Risk and compliance page (admin view). Ask Carry for patient names: it refuses.

name: Minimum cell size on shared aggregates
how_implemented: Patient counts shown to executives and admins are hidden when a clinic-and-condition group has fewer than 5 patients. If either risk band in a group has fewer than 5, both bands are hidden, so the hidden number cannot be calculated by subtraction.
how_to_verify: Care risk page as executive: some cells show "fewer than 5". Test in the sandbox with a small group.

name: Limits on demo data entry
how_implemented: Clinicians can add and remove only demo patients, in their own clinic, at most 30 per clinic, enforced by a trigger and row-level policies. No free text is accepted.
how_to_verify: Patients page: add 31 patients and the limit message appears; seeded patients cannot be removed.

name: Data quality checks
how_implemented: Row counts, reconciliation and freshness checks run live on the Risk and compliance page.
how_to_verify: Risk and compliance page, Data health section.

name: Documented risk analysis and management
how_implemented: This risk register, reviewed by the project author. It is a learning exercise with no external review.
how_to_verify: Risk register on the Risk and compliance page (admin view). Gap: no independent review and no review schedule.
